recipe.title: Pesto pasta with halloumi
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Annabel Langbein's website.

method.s: Cook pasta according to packet instructions. Drain and leave in colander.
While pasta is cooking, cut halloumi into cubes and pan-fry in 2 Tbs of the olive oil, until golden (1 to 2 minutes each side). Drain on a paper towel.
Thin pesto with the remaining 2 Tbs olive oil.
Run hot water over the drained pasta to loosen, shake off excess water, and tip into a serving bowl.
Mix through the thinned pesto, halloumi, halved cherry tomatoes, roasted pine nuts, salt and pepper.
Serve topped with grated parmesan and torn basil leaves.
